Setups are ”Freeling” setups
* Rooks are on the first row
* All other pieces are on the second row
* Pawns on the third row
* No pawn double move
* No castling
With mirror setups, Black’s pieces are inverted left-to-right relative
to White’s pieces.  
Output is setup, then for the first 20 moves, the centipawn advantage
for the move, the move, the win/draw/loss (for White) ratio of the move,
followed by the “sharpness” of the position after the move.
